strongest_angle: IBM has officially launched the Integration Intelligence Hub, a platform that gives AI agents the structured integration context they need to discover, understand and act on enterprise assets.

key_facts.fact: IBM announced the Integration Intelligence Hub on October 26, 2026, positioning it as a way to turn enterprise integration context into structured data for AI agents.
The Hub delivers integration context to AI agents through the open Model Context Protocol (MCP), a capability showcased at IBM TechXchange 2026.
Product Management leaders Jiri De Jagere and Jigdesh Sampath authored the announcement that introduced the Integration Intelligence Hub.
